site_name: חדשות ארכיאולוגיות מעבר לגבול, חפירות בירושלים העתיקה (news from across the border: excavations in the Old City of Jerusalem)
author: (unsigned)
location_note: Jerusalem, Ophel (south-eastern hill) and the east slope of the western hill; no map reference.
notes: Second-hand summary, from the English press, of K. Kenyon's 1961 excavations for the British School of Archaeology; coded because it reports the season's fieldwork. Walls, towers and fortifications not eligible.

site_name: משלחת למדבר יהודה - 1962 (Nahal Mishmar, Cave of the Treasure)
author: P. Bar-Adon
location_note: Nahal Mishmar caves; no map reference.
notes: Bundled with HA 3 in one PDF (HA 2 printed pp. 1-26 = PDF pp. 3-29). Cave B had Bar Kokhba and Chalcolithic remains from earlier seasons (not coded: earlier work). Chalcolithic building and stone lookout on the cliff top not eligible. OCR of this page is poor; quotes chosen from clean words.

site_name: העונה השניה בעין-גדי (En Gedi, second season)
author: B. Mazar, I. Dunayevsky and T. Dothan
location_note: Tel Goren (Tell el-Jurn) and the En Gedi oasis; no map reference.
notes: The report states that Tel Goren has no remains of the end of the Second Temple period or of the time up to the Bar Kokhba revolt. Chalcolithic temple enclosure, Hasmonean fortress and Iron Age tower not eligible.; HA 3 is bound after HA 2 in the portal file (PDF pp. 31-56, own pagination 1-25) and is missing from the portal table of contents; heading found in the text.

site_name: מערות קברים במוצא עילית (burial caves at Moza Illit)
author: V. Sussman
location_note: Ma'ale Moza Illit; no map reference.
notes: HA 3 part of the file; not in the portal table of contents.

site_name: מצדה (Masada)
author: S. Guttman
location_note: Masada, top of the Snake Path; no map reference.
notes: Gate and waiting room with benches and painted plaster at the top of the Snake Path (Herodian style). No feature of the eligible classes.; HA 3 part of the file; not in the portal table of contents.

site_name: חותם עברי נמצא בקרית יערים (Hebrew seal found at Qiryat Ye'arim)
author: (J. Naveh, reported)
location_note: Tell Qiryat Ye'arim (Deir el-Azhar) by Abu Ghosh; no map reference.
notes: Surface find of a seal of Yesha'yahu son of Amaryahu (end of the First Temple period). No feature of the eligible classes.

site_name: רמת רחל (Ramat Rahel, fifth season, first report)
author: Y. Aharoni
location_note: Ramat Rahel; no map reference.
notes: Lower citadel wall, tower and a Roman building of the Tenth Legion not eligible. The intact tomb held two stone ossuaries, remains of wooden coffins, glass and about a dozen lamps.

site_name: קבר מימי הבית השני בירושלים (Second Temple period tomb in Jerusalem, old zoo area)
author: T. Dothan, Z. Yeivin and S. Nahfani
location_note: Area of the old zoo, Jerusalem (Romema); no map reference.
notes: Courtyard 10 x 15 m probably cut in an earlier quarry (not coded: the excavators' inference). Five decorated ossuaries in chamber B and nine in chamber D; an empty arcosolium; a square pit in the entrance chamber. The pottery date is printed as 'המאה הב' לסה״ג' (OCR-ambiguous; not used); the title dates the tomb to the Second Temple period.

site_name: רמת רחל (Ramat Rahel, end of the fifth season)
author: Y. Aharoni (with M. Kochavi)
location_note: Ramat Rahel; no map reference.
notes: Seven strata. Tombs of the late Second Temple village: glass, decorated lamps, ossuaries with Hebrew/Aramaic and Greek inscriptions; one sealed with its blocking stone. A proto-Aeolic capital reused as an altar inside a columbarium connected to a Second Temple tomb cave. A word in the monastery list is unreadable in the text layer ('בריאות'); not coded.

site_name: קברים יהודים ברוממה ירושלים (Jewish tombs in Romema, Jerusalem)
author: L. Y. Rahmani
location_note: Romema, Jerusalem (metal works yard); no map reference.
notes: Twenty-two ossuaries recovered. A later burial in the fill of the northern tomb with a lamp of the 3rd-4th century CE.

site_name: מי נפתוח (Mei Naftoah, Lifta; survey news)
author: (survey staff)
location_note: Mei Naftoah (Lifta), Jerusalem; no map reference.
notes: A large building re-examined and attributed to the Crusader period. No feature of the eligible classes.; Sub-item of 'חדשות מן הסקר'; Mei Naftoah (Lifta) is within Jerusalem (not in the gazetteer by name; exploratory by-eye match).

site_name: חדשות ארכיאולוגיות מחו"ל: הירודיון (news from abroad: Herodium)
author: (from the Vatican bulletin, 2 October 1962)
location_note: Jebel Fureidis, 4 km south-east of Bethlehem (then in Jordan); no map reference.
notes: Second-hand summary of V. Corbo's 1962 excavations: circular fortress, towers, baths with wall paintings, mosaics, Byzantine monks' dwellings, an oven and a lime pit with Roman and Byzantine sherds, a Hebrew ostracon. No feature of the eligible classes (lime pit not eligible).

site_name: קברים מימי הבית הראשון, ליד מבשרת ציון (First Temple period tombs near Mevasseret Yerushalayim)
author: O. Negbi
location_note: Hill slope by the road from Lower Moza to Mevasseret Yerushalayim; no map reference.

site_name: פעולות שימור בירושלים (conservation in Jerusalem: Jason's Tomb, Mamluk tomb buildings)
author: (Department of Antiquities, A. Tiran)
location_note: Jason's Tomb in Alfasi Street; the Kubakiya in Mamilla cemetery and the Qaimariya, Jerusalem; no map reference.
notes: Restoration only; Jason's Tomb was excavated in 1956 (earlier work).

site_name: החפירה ברגם מס' 3 ליד ירושלים (excavation of cairn no. 3 near Jerusalem, Ir Ganim)
author: Z. Yeivin
location_note: Printed as '(נ״צ 128920 165952)', northing first; read as OIG E 165952 / N 128920 (Ir Ganim B, Jerusalem). INFERENCE: swapped order.
notes: Cairn (rujm) of the 7th century BCE with an earlier agricultural terrace; not eligible.

site_name: קבר יסון בירושלים (Jason's Tomb in Jerusalem)
author: (Department of Antiquities)
location_note: Jason's Tomb, Rehavia; no map reference.
notes: Note on the completed restoration; same feature as HA06-016 (Jason's Tomb). Excavated in 1956 (earlier work).

site_name: פפירוסים ארמיים במערה צפונית ליריחו (Aramaic papyri in a cave north of Jericho, Wadi ed-Daliyeh)
author: (from F. M. Cross)
location_note: Mugharet Abu Shinjeh, south side of Wadi ed-Daliyeh, 14 km north of Jericho and 12 km west of the Jordan (text); zone by the title's name (Jericho). INFERENCE: the cave lies within the Z2 or northern Z3 box.
notes: Second-hand report of P. Lapp's January 1963 excavation (then in Jordan). About 40 papyri, 128 bullae, two gold seal rings, 80 skeletons excavated (about 200 estimated); documents of Samaria, 375-335 BCE. Not in a held area (north of Wadi Nuweimeh).

site_name: מצדה (Masada)
author: Y. Yadin
location_note: Masada; no map reference.
notes: Two-line note that the excavations continue; no description.

site_name: מערת קברים בירושלים (tomb cave in Jerusalem, Mount Herzl military cemetery)
author: A. Tiran
location_note: Mount Herzl military cemetery, Jerusalem; no map reference.
notes: Rock-cut courtyard with five steps, a complete ossuary with lid and ossuary fragments, two decorated lamps, a cooking pot; used for several generations; no date stated.

site_name: העונה השלישית בעין-גדי (En Gedi, third season)
author: B. Mazar and I. Dunayevsky
location_note: Tel Goren and the plain between Nahal David and Nahal Arugot, about 200 m west of the shore; no map reference.
notes: Strata V (end of the Judean monarchy) and IV (Persian) on Tel Goren; Herodian lamps in a pit at a higher level (not coded: pit not described). Roman bath house in the plain (hypocaust heating channels not eligible), reused perhaps in the Bar Kokhba period; part of a larger building, perhaps the agora of En Gedi.

site_name: ירושלים, קברים ישראליים וסקר בסביבות ירושלים (Jerusalem: Israelite tombs and survey near Jerusalem)
author: O. Negbi and S. Nahmani; M. Feist
location_note: South-east slope of the Holyland Hotel hill; survey south of Bayit Vegan by the Manahat-Qiryat Yovel road; no map reference.
notes: The excavators link the Holyland caves with the cemetery of biblical Manahat (claim). Survey features were mapped for the Dania company.

site_name: שרידי קבר יהודי בירושלים (remains of a Jewish tomb in Jerusalem, Giv'at Shaul B)
author: L. Y. Rahmani
location_note: Giv'at Shaul B, Jerusalem; no map reference.

site_name: העונה הרביעית בעין גדי (En Gedi, fourth season)
author: B. Mazar and I. Dunayevsky
location_note: Tel Goren and the plain between Nahal David and Nahal Arugot; no map reference.
notes: Persian building (stratum IV) with plastered walls and floors; three Hasmonean-Herodian levels north of it; ovens of the time between the wars or of Bar Kokhba. Roman bath house 40 x 5 m, probably built by the Thracian unit after the destruction of the Second Temple; heating channels not eligible.

site_name: מוצא (Moza, Byzantine church and tomb)
author: A. Druks
location_note: By the Moza Tahtit bridge on the Tel Aviv-Jerusalem road; no map reference.

site_name: מערת קברים בתלפיות (tomb cave in Talpiyyot, Jerusalem)
author: D. Bahat
location_note: 'HaYozem' rest home, Talpiyyot, Jerusalem; no map reference.
notes: Pottery and spindle bottle dated 'למאות הא'-הב׳ לפמה״נ' in the text layer (1st-2nd centuries BCE, OCR); a range that only partly overlaps the window.; Talpiyyot is a Jerusalem neighbourhood (not in the gazetteer by name; exploratory by-eye match).

site_name: מערת קברים יהודית על הר הצופים (Jewish tomb cave on Mount Scopus)
author: (Hebrew University; name garbled in the text layer)
location_note: Botanical garden of the Hebrew University, Mount Scopus; no map reference.
notes: Eight ossuaries (one inscribed 'Yehuda bar Yehohanan'), a Herodian lamp. The author's name is garbled in the text layer.

site_name: העונה החמישית בעין גדי (En Gedi, fifth season)
author: B. Mazar and I. Dunayevsky
location_note: North of Tel Goren, the Roman bath house and 'Givat ha-Matzeva' about 600 m north-west of Tel Goren; no map reference.
notes: Persian residence (stratum IV). Herodian building destroyed in year 2 of the First Revolt (coins). The bath-house pool is the stepped pool of HA13-001 (same feature, described here without steps).

site_name: מצדה (Masada, end of the excavations)
author: Y. Yadin
location_note: Masada; no map reference.
notes: Quoted from Yadin's press statement: Jubilees fragment, about 700 inscribed sherds, about 4000 coins in all seasons, a possible study house of the Zealots, bath-house courtyard mosaic.

site_name: מערה מימי בית שני נחשפה בירושלים (Second Temple period cave exposed in Jerusalem, Tel Arza)
author: (Department of Antiquities)
location_note: End of Zephaniah Street by the Tel Arza quarter, Jerusalem; no map reference.
notes: One plain ossuary and a fragment of another; robbed in antiquity. Pottery and lamps dated to the 2nd and 1st centuries BCE; the title dates the cave to the Second Temple period.

site_name: סקר ארכיאולוגי בעין בוקק (archaeological survey at En Boqeq)
author: S. Applebaum
location_note: En Boqeq and Nahal Boqeq; no map reference. INFERENCE: on the southern edge of the Z3 box.
notes: Fenced agricultural plots and two buildings (one a farm 20 x 20 m). Sherds of the large building from the 2nd century CE on; sherds of the plots probably 5th century CE on. The excavator assumes a dam north of the fort (assumption, not coded).

site_name: ירושלים (Jerusalem: lower aqueduct on Mount Zion; tombs in the Valley of the Cross and Qiryat Menahem)
author: O. Negbi, M. Feist and S. Nahmani; S. Gudovitch
location_note: Mount Zion access road; Valley of the Cross (Emeq ha-Mazleva); Qiryat Menahem; no map references.
notes: Three sub-items under one heading. The aqueduct date is the report's statement of received knowledge ('according to our information').

site_name: פעולות שימור ושיחזור: עין גדי (conservation: En Gedi irrigation network)
author: (Department of Antiquities; Y. Porat)
location_note: En Gedi; sub-item of the conservation report; no map reference.
notes: One line: repairs to the En Gedi irrigation network under antiquities maintenance. Other sub-items (Beth Shean, Acre, Caesarea, Beth Yerah, Hammat, Atlit) are outside the region.

site_name: אתרים קדומים על שפת ים-המלח (ancient sites on the Dead Sea shore south of Ein Feshkha)
author: (survey of I. Blake, British School of Archaeology; reported)
location_note: Dead Sea shore south of Ein Feshkha (then in Jordan); no map reference. Not in a held area (south of Feshkha; no cave report).
notes: Sites from the Chalcolithic to the Byzantine period: walled site on a cliff top, two large shore sites (one with a 360 m wall, buildings and a tower, Iron Age, perhaps flooded), a small perfume workshop of the Early Bronze Age, remains of early Christian hermits' buildings. No feature of the eligible classes described.

site_name: מערת קברים עתיקה בירושלים (ancient tomb cave in Jerusalem, Qiryat Moshe)
author: S. Gudovitch
location_note: Yard of the state religious school, Qiryat Moshe, Jerusalem; no map reference.
notes: Robbed in antiquity; a Herodian lamp dates it.

site_name: מערת קברים יהודית על הר-הצופים (Jewish tomb cave on Mount Scopus)
author: N. Avigad
location_note: Hebrew University grounds, Mount Scopus; no map reference.
notes: Four rock-cut chambers lined with ashlars and vaulted; inscribed ossuaries (Hananya bar Yehonatan) and two stone sarcophagi, one richly decorated.

site_name: אבו ע'וש - 1967 (Abu Ghosh, Neolithic site)
author: G. Dollfus and M. Lechevallier (J. Perrot)
location_note: Abu Ghosh prehistoric site; no map reference.
notes: Spelling variant 'אבו ע'וש' of the gazetteer's 'אבו גוש' (exploratory).

site_name: ירושלים. מצד "מעלה רומאים" (Jerusalem, Herodian road fort, Giv'at Shaul)
author: V. Tzaferis
location_note: Near the new Ezrat Nashim hospital, Giv'at Shaul; no map reference.
notes: Two-storey Herodian fort guarding the Roman road to Emmaus; Byzantine building with five dwelling units and a mosaic workshop; later a lime-slaking installation. No feature of the eligible classes.

site_name: שימור ושחזור: מצודת ירושלים; עין חמד (conservation: Jerusalem Citadel; En Hemed)
author: (Department of Antiquities, Y. Minzker)
location_note: Jerusalem Citadel; En Hemed (Aqua Bella, Deir el-Banat); no map references.
notes: Citadel: war damage and removal of Jordanian additions (no eligible feature). En Hemed: Crusader monastery conserved; 'the spring and the water systems by the spring' supervised; the water systems are not described (class INFERENCE).; En Hemed (Aqua Bella) is not in the gazetteer; it lies inside the Z4 box (exploratory by-eye match).

site_name: חפירות בירושלים 1967 (excavations in Jerusalem 1967, K. M. Kenyon)
author: K. M. Kenyon (report quoted)
location_note: Ophel ridge, east slope above the spring, and the south-west corner of the Old City; no map reference.
notes: Kenyon's own summary of the last season. A pit of the post-destruction period (perhaps 6th century BCE) on the western ridge not coded (pit only). Walls not eligible.

site_name: ירושלים: קברים מימי בית שני בארנונה (Jerusalem, Second Temple period tombs at Arnona)
author: S. Ben-Arieh (V. Tzaferis)
location_note: Arnona, Jerusalem; no map reference.
notes: Round plastered domed entrance hall (diameter 2 m) opening to three caves; west cave with four resh-shaped kokhim and five ossuaries; north cave with four kokhim and ossuaries (one with a Hebrew inscription fragment); an irregular cave without kokhim used for bone collection.

site_name: שימור ושיחזור: ירושלים (conservation: Jerusalem Citadel and walls)
author: (Department of Antiquities and Jerusalem municipality)
location_note: Citadel, Phasael tower and city walls; sub-item of the conservation report.
notes: 'פצאל' in this text is the Phasael tower of the Citadel (namesake of the gazetteer's Phasaelis). No feature of the eligible classes.

site_name: סקר ארכיאולוגי של ישראל: סקר באיזור שכם (survey of the Shechem area)
author: E. F. Campbell (reported)
location_note: Shechem plain; five new tells with map references (Kh. Suwwar 1811/1779, el-Kharaba 1796/1805, Diara 1805/1805, Rujib 1780/1774 in Z1; Tell Kuma 1707/1852 outside); Salim 1815/1796.
notes: 41 sites; settlement history by period. 'Very interesting details about the water supply' of Aruma (Kh. el-Urma) are mentioned but not described; not coded. No feature of the eligible classes described.

site_name: הר אפרים ובנימין – מרכז (חולייה מס' 5) (emergency survey, central Ephraim and Benjamin)
author: Z. Kallai
location_note: Survey area from Jerusalem to Mount Ebal (Z1, Z3 and Z4 parts and outside the boxes); one map reference (1737/1647, outside).
notes: Settlement history by period (Ein Fara, Kh. Marjama, Kh. Radana, Nebi Samwil area, Gerizim slopes, Michmash, Almit, Geba, Gibeon). A general sentence on Roman-Byzantine 'water storage installations, oil presses, churches' gives no site; unlocated, not coded. No site-specific feature of the eligible classes inside the boxes.; TIER-1 RECORD: Kh. Almit: two passing mentions (printed p. 23, PDF p. 28); extraction only in part_a/tier1_kh_almit_extraction.md (2b2a4bc), committed after this row was first committed (ac45765); nothing coded from them

site_name: מדבר יהודה ובקעת הירדן (חולייה מס' 6) (emergency survey, Judean Desert and Jordan Valley)
author: P. Bar-Adon
location_note: Judean Desert, Jericho plains and Jordan Valley to the Damiya bridge (Z2, Z3); no map references.
notes: About 300 sites. The caves sub-section ('המערות', printed p. 28) was read to its first lines only and held as a precaution (cave survey whose areas were not established; plan section 7). Iron Age forts and wall lines not eligible.

site_name: יהודה (חולייה מס' 7) (emergency survey, Judea)
author: M. Kochavi
location_note: Judean hills from Jerusalem to the Negev border and the high Shephelah; the in-region part is the Bethlehem-Gush Etzion-Betar-Tekoa area (Z4). No map references.
notes: Features named are outside the boxes (tombs near Adoraim and Ziph; a nefesh at Ziph; decorated tombs near a Kh. Samiya and Kh. Juf in the Hebron hills). Inside Z4: Israelite settlements near Gush Etzion, forts on the Elah-Bethlehem road, Kh. Abu Shun and Roman forts around Betar, the Tekoa road; none of the eligible classes.

site_name: ירושלים: קברים יהודיים בגבעת המבתר (Jerusalem, Jewish tombs at Giv'at ha-Mivtar)
author: V. Tzaferis
location_note: Giv'at ha-Mivtar, north Jerusalem; no map reference.
notes: Four tomb caves; the text layer of the first page is badly garbled. Ossuaries with inscriptions ('Simon builder of the Temple'; Yehohanan son of Hagqol, heel bones joined by a nail). Cave 2 with Hasmonean pottery.

site_name: ירושלים: בנייני האומה (Jerusalem, Binyanei ha-Umma)
author: M. Avi-Yonah
location_note: Binyanei ha-Umma grounds, Jerusalem; no map reference.
notes: Pottery kiln of the end of the Second Temple period, Tenth Legion brick and tile works; Byzantine refuse pits and installations (not eligible).

site_name: ירושלים: רחוב אלפסי (Jerusalem, Alfasi Street)
author: (Department of Antiquities)
location_note: 54 Alfasi Street, Jerusalem; no map reference.

site_name: ירושלים: קרית יובל (Jerusalem, Qiryat Yovel)
author: A. Eitan
location_note: Qiryat Yovel, Jerusalem; no map reference.

site_name: אתר עתיק בסביבת יריחו (ancient site near Jericho)
author: G. M. Landes
location_note: About 3 km north of Jericho by the widened road; no map reference.
notes: Strata: Early Roman (1st century CE), Iron II (late 7th-early 6th century BCE) houses, late Chalcolithic round building and granary (not eligible).

site_name: ח' סמרא במדבר יהודה (Kh. Samra in the Judean Desert)
author: P. Bar-Adon
location_note: North bank of Nahal Arugot; no map reference.
notes: Dry-stone dwelling cells with benches, hearths, granaries and wall niches; Byzantine pottery (5th-6th centuries CE); probably monks or hermits. No feature of the eligible classes.

site_name: הפעולה הארכיאולוגית ביהודה ושומרון: עין סאמיה (Ein Samiya cemetery)
author: (Judea and Samaria staff officer)
location_note: Ein Samiya area east of Kafr Malik on the Jericho-Ramallah road; no map reference.
notes: Spelling 'סאמיה' of the gazetteer's 'סמיה' (prefix and spelling variant).

site_name: הפעולה הארכיאולוגית ביהודה ושומרון: שומרון — מערת קברים ממזרח לשכם (tomb cave east of Shechem)
author: (Judea and Samaria staff; inspector Ibrahim Amin el-Fani)
location_note: About 3 km east of Shechem (text); sub-item of the Samaria district notes. INFERENCE: inside the Z1 box.
notes: Other Samaria-district notes (a Hellenistic pool of 25 m³ and a cistern with a reused Herodian column at Samaria-Sebaste) are outside the boxes and not coded.

site_name: שכם ותל אר-ראס - 1968 (Shechem and Tell er-Ras 1968)
author: E. F. Campbell and H. O. Thompson; R. G. Boling, J. F. Ross, L. E. Toombs
location_note: Tell Balata and Tell er-Ras (north spur of Mount Gerizim above Balata); no map reference.
notes: Tell er-Ras: Hadrianic temple of Zeus Hypsistos (about 130 CE) on a Hellenistic platform; Byzantine fortification and chapel; 'several structures related to water supply from the time of Constantine' (not described, not coded). Tell Balata: Amarna-period cellar with pottery (not eligible).

site_name: הפעולה הארכיאולוגית ביהודה ושומרון: צור באהר (Sur Bahir tomb)
author: (inspector Azmi Khalil Mustafa)
location_note: Sur Bahir near Jerusalem; no map reference.

site_name: אבו ע'וש - 1968 (Abu Ghosh, Neolithic site)
author: G. Dollfus and M. Lechevallier
location_note: Abu Ghosh Neolithic site; no map reference.
notes: Houses of the Pre-Pottery Neolithic B horizon; a large trench with Byzantine sherds. Tier-1 volume: extraction committed first (tier1_HA28-29_extraction.md).; Spelling variant: 'אבו ע'וש' for the gazetteer's 'אבו גוש' (exploratory variant match).

site_name: ירושלים: סקר בכפר השילוח (Jerusalem, survey in the village of Silwan)
author: D. Ussishkin (with G. Barkay)
location_note: Silwan village, east slope of the Kidron opposite the City of David; no map reference.
notes: Tier-1 volume (extraction committed first). Monolithic tombs: 'Tomb of Pharaoh's Daughter' (rock-cut pyramid destroyed by later quarrying), the '...yahu asher al ha-bayit' tomb (two chambers) and a third monolith with a Hebrew inscription, about 5.25 m wide and 4.23 m high, now a cistern under a courtyard. No facade orientation stated.

site_name: ירושלים: "מערת האשכולות" (Jerusalem, Cave of the Grapes)
author: (Department of Antiquities)
location_note: North-east Jerusalem, near the Sanhedriya garden; no map reference.
notes: Tier-1 volume (extraction committed first). Facade with carvings below the lintel cleared; interior not cleaned; no date given.

site_name: ירושלים: מערות ברחוב שמואל הנביא (Jerusalem, caves in Shmuel ha-Navi Street)
author: (district archaeologist)
location_note: Shmuel ha-Navi Street, corner of Yehezkel Street; no map reference.
notes: Tier-1 volume (extraction committed first). Tomb 1: 19 ossuaries, two coins of the procurators of the 50s CE. Tomb system 2: three units, kokhim and arcosolia; a vertical entrance from the courtyard into a pit closed with a blocking stone; later dwellings with Early Arab pottery.

site_name: פעולות שימור: ירושלים (conservation: Jerusalem city walls)
author: (Jerusalem municipality and Department of Antiquities)
location_note: Old City walls; sub-item of the conservation report.
notes: Sub-item of 'פעולות שימור' (TOC item 30). City walls only; no feature of the eligible classes.

site_name: הרודיון (Herodium)
author: G. Foerster
location_note: Herodium, upper palace; no map reference.
notes: Conservation of the palace excavated by V. Corbo 1963-1967 (peristyle, bath house and frigidarium dome); small finds (ostraca, coins, stone vessels, arrowheads, ballista stones). No feature of the eligible classes described.

site_name: ח' תאנאניר ליד שכם (Kh. Tananir near Shechem)
author: R. Boling
location_note: On the lower slopes of Mount Gerizim (text); no map reference.
notes: Square building first found by the German expedition in 1931, dated by floor and foundation-trench finds to Middle Canaanite II B III, cultic. A small round structure about 200 m west of the main building (not eligible). Ribbed sherds, stone tesserae and walls indicate Roman-Byzantine building; the report does not tie this date to the pool. site_name: עין בוקק (En Boqeq, first season)
author: M. Gichon
location_note: En Boqeq: the Roman-Byzantine fort and the Hasmonean-Herodian farm; no map reference. INFERENCE: southern edge of the Z3 box.

site_name: ירושלים: המצודה (Jerusalem, the Citadel)
author: R. Amiran and A. Eitan
location_note: Citadel courtyard, inside the line of the Second Temple period wall; no map reference.
notes: Stratum III Herodian building against the wall (89 coins, all before the First Revolt); stratum IV earlier building. The stratum I channels were exposed and dated to the Roman period by C. N. Johns (earlier work).

site_name: ירושלים: הרובע היהודי (Jerusalem, Jewish Quarter checks 1968)
author: A. Ovadiah and E. Menczel
location_note: Karaite synagogue; Crusader church of St Mary of the Germans; Batei Mahse and Rothschild house courtyard; Misgav Ladach hospital; no map references.
notes: Crusader church and monastery halls, a Crusader street (not eligible). The pool is compared by the authors to the Struthion pool. The author names are partly garbled in the text layer.

site_name: ירושלים: מערות קברים (Jerusalem, tomb caves: Giv'at ha-Mivtar, police school, Ben Zvi Boulevard)
author: S. Gudovitch
location_note: Giv'at ha-Mivtar; road by the police school; Ben Zvi Boulevard; no map references.
notes: One kokhim cave robbed (Giv'at ha-Mivtar); one with 18 ossuaries, mostly decorated, one inscribed, Herodian lamps (police school); three robbed kokhim caves with three ossuaries (Ben Zvi Boulevard).

site_name: בית מלאכה מימי הבית השני בסביבות ירושלים (Second Temple period workshop near Jerusalem, Jebel Mukabbir)
author: (Department of Antiquities; K. Cooper)
location_note: Jebel Mukabbir, south-east of Jerusalem (by Beit Hanina children's home); no map reference.
notes: Waste of stone measuring cups dumped into the quarry cave; the workshop stood above it.

site_name: צובה (Zova)
author: S. Ben-Arieh
location_note: Kibbutz Zova; no map reference.

site_name: הרודיון (Herodium, 1969 conservation and clearing)
author: G. Foerster
location_note: Herodium, upper palace; no map reference.
notes: Exedra and palace gate with frescoes; gate destroyed by fire; about 30 ostraca; an inkwell like those of Qumran. An entrance tunnel built in the fill (not eligible).

site_name: בדיקות באתרים בין עין פשחה לעין גדי (sites between Ein Feshkha and En Gedi: Ein el-Ghuweir)
author: P. Bar-Adon
location_note: Dead Sea shore between Ein el-Ghuweir and Ein et-Turaba, about 15 km south of Qumran; no map reference. Not a held area (south of Ein Feshkha; built site and cemetery).
notes: Large building 45 x 20 m with hall and two rooms, burnt layer with coins of Herod, Archelaus and Agrippa I (37 BCE-46 CE), stone measuring vessel, Herodian lamp; interpreted as an Essene centre (CLAIM). Iron Age building and a 600 m wall with about 20 rooms (not eligible). The author also asserts that Kh. Qumran should be identified with Secacah 'according to the Copper Scroll' (CLAIM; noted only).

site_name: בית חורון תחתון (Lower Beth Horon)
author: Z. Kallai (students' survey)
location_note: Lower Beth Horon (Beit Ur et-Tahta); no map reference. Zone by the title's gazetteer name; INFERENCE: the village lies just west of the Z4 box.
notes: A movable stone dyeing installation found in a courtyard and taken to the Rockefeller building. No feature of the eligible classes.

site_name: גבעון (Gibeon, site improvements)
author: (Staff officer for archaeology, military government)
location_note: Gibeon (el-Jib); no map reference.
notes: Paths and steps to the pool, the tunnel entrance and the spring; stone walls around the pool strengthened. The features are those excavated by J. B. Pritchard (earlier work); none is dated in this note.; Gibeon (el-Jib) is not in the gazetteer; it lies inside the Z4 box (exploratory by-eye match).

site_name: ח' רדנה (Kh. Radana)
author: J. A. Callaway
location_note: By the police offices in Ramallah; no map reference.
notes: Iron Age I house; fragments of a multi-handled offering bowl with a tube and two animal heads; jar handle incised with letters (end of the 11th century BCE). No feature of the eligible classes.; Not in the gazetteer by its own name; the text places it by the police offices in Ramallah, and Ramallah is a Z4 gazetteer name. INFERENCE: the site lies at about the northern edge of the Z4 box.

author: (inspector Ibrahim el-Fani)
location_note: Nablus (municipal works); no map reference.

site_name: ירושלים: הרובע היהודי (Jerusalem, Jewish Quarter sounding by St Mary of the Germans)
author: I. Margovsky
location_note: By the Crusader church of St Mary of the Germans; no map reference.
notes: Eight strata; buildings of the end of the 2nd and the 1st century BCE (not eligible); Herodian stratum badly destroyed.

site_name: ירושלים: שרידי מצד ליד הגבעה הצרפתית (Jerusalem, fort remains by French Hill)
author: O. Negbi
location_note: Foot of French Hill, north-east Jerusalem; no map reference.
notes: Podium of a fort 21 x 17 m, late Iron Age or early Persian pottery, a Yehud coin. No feature of the eligible classes.

site_name: ירושלים: שיפוץ מצבות נחל קדרון (Jerusalem, renovation of the Kidron valley monuments)
author: E. Oren (supervision)
location_note: Kidron valley: Absalom's Pillar, Tomb of Jehoshaphat, Tomb of Zechariah; no map reference.
notes: Fresco remains in the Tomb of Jehoshaphat (a Christian chapel in the Middle Ages). The original courtyard of the Jehoshaphat tomb extended west under the road; a cistern west of the road may have belonged to it (excavators' suggestion, not coded separately). The 1960 finds at Zechariah's tomb (square niche, steps, plastered cistern) are earlier work; the arched structures and cistern removed now are not earlier than the Mamluk period. Finds from Roman (Herodian lamp) to Early Arab.

site_name: סקר אמות המים הקדומות לירושלים ולהרודיון (survey of the ancient aqueducts to Jerusalem and Herodium)
author: Y. Cohen and A. Mazar (Kfar Etzion field school)
location_note: Solomon's Pools, Wadi Arrub, Wadi Biyar, Bethlehem, Jebel Mukabbir, Emeq Refaim, Artas to Herodium; no map references. INFERENCE: the Arrub sources lie on the southern edge of Z4; the rest inside Z4.
notes: Arrub aqueduct 41 km from Ein Kuweiziba to the middle pool, with tunnels and two guard towers; Wadi Biyar tunnel 2.5 km with dozens of shafts up to 25 m deep (compared to Roman-period qanats); an underground ashlar room with a barrel vault typical of the Roman period (function unknown); lower aqueduct tunnels under Bethlehem and Jebel Mukabbir (about 400 m); upper aqueduct with stone-pipe segments in the Rachel's Tomb valley (over 2 km) and on the east edge of Emeq Refaim; tunnels of Ein Saleh, Ein Burak and Ein Farujeh; Herodium aqueduct from Ein Artas. None dated by the report except by comparison.

site_name: הסקר הארכיאולוגי ביהודה (archaeological survey in Judea, Bethlehem to Hebron)
author: S. Guttman
location_note: From Bethlehem to the Hebron area and the Hebron-Bet Guvrin road; the in-region part is Bethlehem. No map references.
notes: General observations on Mishnah-Talmud period villages (caves under houses with cisterns, oil presses, winepresses, cupmarks, dyeing installations) not tied to sites; unlocated, not coded. In Bethlehem: Iron II pottery south of the Church of the Nativity (no feature).

site_name: ירושלים: הרובע היהודי (Jerusalem, Jewish Quarter 1969, site A)
author: N. Avigad (director)
location_note: Jewish Quarter of the Old City, opposite the Temple Mount; no map reference.
notes: Nine settlement phases from the end of the Iron Age to the Crusader period; 7th-century BCE settlement; Hasmonean public buildings; fresco fragments and Ionic capitals attributed to a palace of the 1st century BCE (coins of Alexander Jannaeus and Herod). The report's term is 'מקווי מים'; coded ritual_bath (INFERENCE: miqvaot in Avigad's usage).

site_name: ירושלים: המצודה - 1969 (Jerusalem, the Citadel, 1969)
author: R. Amiran and A. Eitan
location_note: Citadel by the Jaffa Gate; no map reference.
notes: Second season: Herodian podium buildings and wall, Hellenistic wall and tower, Iron Age fill. No feature of the eligible classes.

site_name: ירושלים: הר הצופים (Jerusalem, Mount Scopus, Jewish family tomb)
author: E. Oren
location_note: Near Lord Grey's house on Mount Scopus; no map reference.
notes: Rock-cut courtyard, kokhim room, bone-collecting room with an ashlar wall, ossuary storage room; built central pit; four decorated ossuaries.

site_name: ביהודה ושומרון: הורקניה (Judea and Samaria: Hyrcania, aqueduct survey)

site_name: בית הכנסת בנערן (the synagogue at Naaran)
author: P. Bar-Adon
location_note: Ein Duk (Naaran); no map reference.
notes: Mosaic re-exposed; zodiac inscriptions; conservation. No feature of the eligible classes.

The report's term for the pools is 'מקווה מים'; coded ritual_bath (INFERENCE: miqveh in Avigad's usage).

site_name: ירושלים: קברים מימי בית שני (Jerusalem, tombs of the Second Temple period)

location_note: Giv'at ha-Mivtar; east slope of Mount Scopus; Giv'at Ram (Hebrew University); Isawiya (Ras el-Jami'a), north of Mount Scopus; no map references.

Isawiya: dressed building stones and plaster in the courtyard, probably from a structure over the tomb; a coin from a ceiling crack does not date the tomb.

No feature of the eligible classes.; Zone by the Ramallah location given in HA 31-32 and HA 43 (gazetteer name Ramallah).

site_name: ירושלים: הרובע היהודי (Jerusalem, Jewish Quarter, area A)
author: N. Avigad
location_note: Jewish Quarter, area A; no map reference.

notes: Tomb A: vaulted entrance room and kokhim chamber, sealed kokhim, ossuaries (one with a stylised pyramid tomb); tomb B 13 m north (Herodian lamp); tomb C 30 m north (late Hasmonean finds).

author: V. Tzaferis

notes: 44 tombs cleared, five partly robbed. Double shaft tomb 204/204a sealed, with a silver cup decorated with Mesopotamian-Syrian mythological figures (grave goods, not a cache). Continues HA36-011.

The spring name above the fort is garbled in the text layer.

site_name: פעולות שימור ביהודה ובשומרון (conservation in Judea and Samaria: Naaran, Tell Jericho)

notes: Naaran mosaic repaired and shelter completed; fencing of Tell Jericho and its sections, paths and steps for visitors. No feature of the eligible classes.

author: D. Bahat
location_note: Armenian Garden, Old City; no map reference.

site_name: ירושלים: כותרת יונית מונומנטלית ברובע היהודי (Jerusalem, monumental Ionic capital in the Jewish Quarter)
author: (N. Avigad cited)

author: Y. Margovsky

notes: Area A: 12th-century CE tower under Burj Kabrit; four strata (Turkish aqueduct, medieval tower, Byzantine mosaics and street, Herodian street). The term 'מקווה מים' is coded ritual_bath (INFERENCE: the Hebrew word for miqveh); in the Byzantine stratum it may mean a water basin.

site_name: ירושלים: הגבעה "הצרפתית" - ב' (Jerusalem, French Hill B, kokhim tombs)
